s: Pull your shoulder blades back and down, eyes under the bar, feet planted.

Lower for 2 sec to the lower chest, elbows ~45° to the torso.
Touch without bouncing, press up and slightly back toward the rack.

Bouncing the bar off the chest.
bench.easy: Dumbbell bench press or machine chest press.
bench.alt: Smith machine press, dumbbell bench press.

s: Bench at 30°, kick the dumbbells up from your knees.

Lower to chest level, elbows at 45°.
Press in an arc — dumbbells come together but don't clank.
e: Bench at 45°+ — it all shifts to the shoulders.
Clanking the dumbbells at the top.
incline.alt: Incline barbell press, Smith machine at 30°.

s: Support on straight arms, shoulders down away from the ears.
Slight forward lean, legs slightly back.
Lower to 90° at the elbows — no deeper.
Press back up to straight arms.

dip.easy: Assisted dip machine or bench dips.

s: Dead hang, grip slightly wider than shoulders, abs and glutes tight.

s: Palms facing you, shoulder-width grip.

bentrow.easy: Chest-supported dumbbell row on an incline bench.

s: Knee and hand on the bench, back parallel to the floor.
Dumbbell hangs under the shoulder.
Pull to the hip — elbow back and up, not out.
Stretch the lat at the bottom without twisting the torso.

s: Bar on the upper chest, grip slightly wider than shoulders, glutes and abs tight.
Head slightly back — bar travels straight up.
Once the bar clears the forehead, push the head forward under the bar.
Lower to the chest under control.
ohp.easy: Seated dumbbell press with back support.
ohp.alt: Seated dumbbells, seated Smith machine press.

s: Slight forward lean, arms slightly bent.
Raise out to the sides leading with the elbow, up to shoulder height.
Shoulders away from the ears, pinky no higher than the thumb.
Lower slower than you lift.
Cable at face height, overhand grip on the rope.
Step back, torso upright.
Pull toward the eyes, spreading the rope, elbows high.
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the end, return slowly.
e: Going heavy — this is a light exercise.

s: Bench at 45–60°, arms hang straight behind the torso.
Curl while turning the palm up, elbows stay put.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower for 3 sec to straight arms — the stretch is the point.
e: Cutting the range short at the bottom.

s: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing each other.
Curl without changing grip, elbows tucked.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
hammer.easy: Rope hammer curl on the low cable.
hammer.alt: Rope hammer curl on the low cable.

s: Back to the cable, rope behind the head, step forward.
Elbows point forward and up and don't move.
Extend forward and up to straight arms.
Return slowly into a deep stretch.
Bar on the traps, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Belly breath, brace the abs like a barrel.
Hips back and down, knees tracking the toes, to parallel.
Drive up through the whole foot, exhale at the top.
e: Lower back rounding at the bottom.

s: Shoulder blades on the bench, bar across the hips (with a pad).
Feet set so the shins are vertical at the top.
Drive the hips up to a straight line, chin tucked.
Pause 1 sec squeezing the glutes, lower under control.
e: Arching the lower back at the top.
Feet too far out — hamstrings take over.
hip.easy: Bodyweight bridge or hip thrust machine.

s: Rear foot on the bench, front foot a big step forward.
Slight forward lean, dumbbells in hand.
Lower straight down, rear knee almost to the floor.
Drive up through the front heel.
e: Front foot too close to the bench.
bulgarian.easy: Bodyweight or holding on for support.

s: Pad above the heels, knees aligned with the machine's pivot.
Curl all the way, hips pinned.
Pause 1 sec.
Release for 3 sec.
Toes on the edge of the platform, heels down.
Drop the heels as low as possible — 1-sec stretch.
Rise all the way onto the toes.
Pause 1 sec at the top.
calf.alt: Calf raises on the leg press.

s: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the knees.
Hips down, chest up, back flat, bar against the shins.
Breathe, brace — push the floor away, bar slides along the legs.
Stand tall without leaning back, lower the same way.
e: Bar drifting away from the legs.
Hips shooting up before the shoulders.

s: Hang, shoulders active, legs together.
Knees to the chest while curling the pelvis up — that's the key.
Pause at the top.
Lower for 2 sec without swinging.
e: Swinging the legs — that's hip flexors.
hanging.easy: Knee raises on the captain's chair or lying down.
hanging.q: hanging leg raise proper form abs

s: Kneel at the cable, rope at your head.
Hips stay still — don't sit back on your heels.
Crunch: ribs toward the pelvis, forehead toward the knees.
Return slowly.
On your knees, wheel under the shoulders, back slightly rounded.
Roll forward with the pelvis tucked — lower back doesn't sag.
Go as far as you can hold straight.
Pull back with the abs.

roll.easy: Short range or roll out to a wall.
roll.q: ab wheel rollout from knees form

Press up without clanking the dumbbells.
Lower to ear level over 2 sec.

Extend to straight arms, spread the rope ends.
Return up to 90° at the elbow.
Bar at the hips, knees slightly bent — the angle doesn't change.
Hips back, bar slides along the thighs.
Down to a strong stretch just below the knees, back flat.
Stand up by driving the hips forward.
Knees slightly bent, back flat.
Pull the handle to the lower belly, elbows along the torso.
Squeeze the shoulder blades for 1 sec.
Release into a stretch without rounding the lower back.
e: Pulling with the arms, not the shoulder blades.

Lower to 90° at the knees or deeper.
Knees track the toes.
Drive up without locking the knees.
Thighs under the pad, grip slightly wider than shoulders.

Pull to the upper chest, elbows down and back.
Return under control into a stretch.

Hips stay on the seat.
Press without locking the knees.

Lower to chest level, elbows at 45°.
Press in an arc.
Dumbbells don't clank at the top.
Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body straight.
Lower the chest almost to the floor, elbows at 45°.
Abs tight.
Press up to straight arms.
pushup.easy: From the knees or off a bench.

s: Dumbbell or kettlebell at the chest, elbows down.
Feet shoulder width.
Sit deep, elbows between the knees, torso upright.
Drive up through the heels.
Torso at 45°, back flat, dumbbells under the chest.
Raise out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.

Lower slowly.

s: Chest on the pad, feet braced.
Pull the handles toward you, elbows back.
Squeeze the shoulder blades.
Release under control.
On the elbow under the shoulder, feet together.
Hips up — body in one straight line.
Hold for time on each side.
Breathe steadily.

ULF3.desc: 3 days. Bench and squat twice a week, deadlift once

PPL3.desc: 3 days. Presses, pulls, legs — the classic for experienced lifters

FB2.desc: 2 days. Whole body in one session, when time is short

UL4.desc: 4 days. Strength early in the week, volume at the end

weeks.txt: Ramp-up: ~75% of previous weights, 2–3 reps in reserve. Log how it feels — the program will adjust the load.
Working week: ~85%, one extra set, 1–2 reps in reserve. Where it felt easy, the weight is already up.
Progression: the program drives the weights from your logs. Every session — a little more.
